theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트
theme_rankings.why_now: AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출. 미국 AI 주식 테마와 동행 흐름.
theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들
theme_rankings.why_now: 솔라나 압도적 점유 + 신흥 L1(Sui·Aptos)도 자금 유입. 생태계 prop value 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라
theme_rankings.why_now: BTC ETF 자금 유입, ETH 스테이킹 + L2 매출. 알트 사이클의 출발점.
theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

top_news.title: Reform Should Cut Back Britain’s State Pension, Think Tank Says
top_news.summary: A think tank linked to Reform UK has suggested that Nigel Farage’s party should reduce the state pension to a means-tested safety net, if it comes to power.

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 23
top_news.summary: Oil extended losses as the US flagged progress in talks with Iran to end their war, and Saudi Arabia moved to restart a key pipeline.

top_news.title: Apollo Caps Private Credit Fund Again as 14.7% Look to Exit
top_news.summary: Apollo Global Management Inc. is limiting redemptions from a private credit fund for the third straight quarter, as its investors join the rush to pull cash from the $1.8 trillion direct lending market.

top_news.title: Murat Kurum Outlines COP31 Action Plan
top_news.summary: Murat Kurum, President, COP31; Minister of Environment, Urbanization & Climate Change, Republic of Türkiye discusses his action plan for the Antalya summit at the COP31 Business Forum New York Dialogue at Bloomberg Green New York 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Fort Trump Will Come to Poland, Says President Nawrocki
top_news.summary: Poland President Karol Nawrocki says it's just a matter of time before a permanent US military base is built in his country. Nawrocki says he hopes "Fort Trump" is completed before Trump's term ends in 2029. Nawrocki speaks exclusively to Bloomberg's Francine Lacqua on the sidelines of UN General Assembly meeting in New York. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: CFTC Warns Prediction Markets to Reel in Risky ‘Mention’ Bets
top_news.summary: Prediction market wagers involving bets on what high-profile people might say in public present heightened manipulation risk and can only be offered in limited circumstances, Commodity Futures Trading Commission staff warned in new guidance.

top_news.title: Anthony Scaramucci's "All the Wrong Moves"
top_news.summary: Former Trump Administration official and Founder of Skybridge, Anthony Scaramucci, is out with a new book "All the Wrong Moves: How Three Catastrophic Decisions Led to the Rise of Trump." He joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss the lessons he learned from his time on Wall Street to his short-lived time in the White House and extended exposure to the Trump-world. He tries to make the case for what bipartisan money mistakes lead to today's "political crisis" and how we can get out of it.

top_news.title: COP31 Business Forum Chair on Climate Goals
top_news.summary: Rifat Hisarcıklıoğlu, President, Union of Chambers and Commodity Exchanges of Türkiye (TOBB); Chair, COP31 Business Forum delivers welcome remarks at the COP31 Business Forum New York Dialogue at Bloomberg Green New York 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Oil Traders Bet on Price Drop at Record Pace as Disruptions Ease
top_news.summary: Oil traders are flocking to options betting on a decline in Brent crude, with bearish wagers surging to unprecedented levels as investors reposition after a blistering rally in recent sessions.

top_news.title: Traders Load Up on Hedges for Shallower Fed Rate-Hike Cycle
top_news.summary: Traders are shielding themselves from the possibility that the Federal Reserve raises interest rates less than markets are currently pricing in.
